target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of semantic memory using a fact extraction and update ledger. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Derive semantic memory — human review
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of semantic memory using a fact extraction and update ledger. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.artifact: a fact extraction and update ledger

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a fact extraction and update ledger.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report fact consistency after updates with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: silently overwriting contradictory sources.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of semantic memory.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report fact consistency after updates against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for silently overwriting contradictory sources; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
